role: development-only FMM-arrival regularization of local FD joint origin-time/amplitude inversion
objective: min over discrete origin times of normalized full-window waveform MSE with analytical nonnegative scalar gain, plus alpha times mean squared (origin + receiver FMM travel - corrected pick)/0.10 s
interpretation: The two events, local grids, picker bias, and FMM fields have already been inspected or developed. This is an in-sample diagnostic, not an independent localization result. The amplitude is a free scalar, and the FMM and FD discretizations differ.
